content:
mira: Quick sync — ACME HW + SI want to list an integrated appliance + managed service in Azure and GCP marketplaces. They asked for SOC2 report, recent pen test writeup, and HSM attestation artifacts. Who can own packaging + what can we actually share? cc @alex @sam @jordana

alex: I can take ownership of the SOC/pen-test side. Question: do they want full SOC or just the cover letter + auditor statement?

sam: For marketplace we usually provide a redacted SOC2 (remove customer/ops details) + a summary of high/medium findings. Full reports go to legal-only under NDA.

mira: Good — so plan: public redacted SOC2, private presigned bundle for SI under NDA. Need timeline and TTL for presigned links.

jordana: Timeline: partner expects listing in ~6 weeks. We need artifacts packaged and a security attestation by week 3 to start marketplace review.

olivia (Security): Pen-test: we have a third-party report from last quarter. We can provide a one-page executive summary + CVE matrix. Full vuln report requires signed DPA/NDA and an access request form. Also: HSM attestation — is this customer-managed HSM or partner-managed?

acme-brian: Partner note: it's partner-managed HSM on their appliance. They need an attestation letter from us that keys never leave device and that firmware signing is enforced.

edward (Legal): We can provide a vendor attestation letter template. For SOC2, legal needs to review redactions before publish. Any shared full reports must be gatekept by a signed NDA + POA. Also watch for export controls on crypto attestations.

alex: Proposal for artifact split: [public] redacted SOC2 cover + auditor opinion, pen-test summary, published attestation statement (non-sensitive). [private] full SOC2 (NDA), full pen-test (NDA + controlled viewer), HSM firmware signing log excerpts (NDA).

sam: Presign TTL suggestion: 7 days by default, extension request via partner-ops. Store blobs in a restricted bucket, tag with `marketplace-onboarding` and partner id. Example presign cmd we use internally:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/acme-onboard/ACME_SOC2_redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

jordana: Ops note: partner-ops will provision a temporary access group and add ACME contact to an SSO invite for artifact download. Need to coordinate with infra for audit logging.

olivia (Security): Add a checklist item: anonymize any IPs, remove internal hostnames, scrub AWS account ids. Also redact any screenshots containing customer data.

edward (Legal): I'll review the redaction pass. Also suggest adding a short addendum stating the scope of the SOC2 (in-scope services) so reviewers on marketplace understand boundaries.

mira: Who will produce the draft attestation letter? alex or edward?

alex: I can draft the tech attestation (HSM + key handling) and send to @edward for legal language.

edward (Legal): ACK. I will produce NDA template and signoff checklist.

acme-brian: One ask from partner: can we include a sanitized firmware signing log snippet? they said it helps marketplace reviewers.

olivia (Security): We can include a signing log excerpt with key IDs hashed. Example line: `firmware.bin signed_by: key-12f3... (hash redacted)` — OK with me if hashed and no private key material.

sam: Also note: Azure marketplace requests a single ZIP of artifacts plus an attestation PDF. GCP wants items uploaded separately. We'll need two packaging formats.

jordana: I'll create a checklist in the partner tracker: artifact list, redaction owner, presign owner, NDA owner, infra ticket id, target dates.

mira: Great. Actions: alex draft attestation and redaction plan by EOD Friday; edward prepare NDA + legal review timeline; olivia scrub pen-test summary and signing log excerpt; jordana open infra ticket and create tracker doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue with ACME. :calendar: :thumbsup:

security-bot: Reminder: when sharing sensitive artifacts, add DLP scan tag and set bucket lifecycle to 30d temp retention.

mira: Thanks everyone — we'll use this thread as the single source for artifact ownership. If anything changes ping me directly.

acme-brian: Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Looking forward to the sync.
